summary: Expand the source marker for the existing thriving-child example to its supplied verse reference.

summary: Assign prayer being heard to Detransitive sense 1, not thriving sense 2.
rationale: Patient prayer with m- Lord corresponds to acceptance/hearing. An explicit Detransitive sense list is supplied.

summary: Assign the answered-prayer example to sense 1
rationale: The quotation says the prayer is heard/accepted by its Lord, confirmed by 90/15 ('Das Gebet ... wird ... erhört'). Stem III sense 1 explicitly contains 'erhören'; sense 2 is intransitive 'sich gut entwickeln, gedeihen, sich herausmachen'. Keep the example in its Detransitive Infectum box and change only its semantic number.

summary: New box Nomen Actionis: example for sense 1 in Nomen Actionis (36/59)

data.turoyo: Maḥatle iḏe b kiste, mofaqle u maktub, ftəḥle, ḥzele: ga kale yo Mḥammad Bag, u ʕmiro d Gziro, harke b Ṣṭambəl w koṭoləb i mqabale du šulṭono.
data.translation: Er steckte seine Hand in die Tasche, holte den Brief heraus, öffnete ihn und sah: Muhammed Bäg, der Emir von Dschezire, ist hier in Stambul und wünscht eine Begegnung mit dem Sultan.

rationale: Nomen Actionis audience; do not label the loan-shaped noun a productive Infinitiv.

summary: New sense 1b: (fig., mit ḥḏoḏe) einander entsprechen, sich die Waage halten;

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: (fig., mit ḥḏoḏe) einander entsprechen, sich die Waage halten;

rationale: Abstract good and bad deeds are brought into reciprocal correspondence, rather than a personal audience. One clear attestation; exact balancing strength and stem vocalism remain questions.

summary: New sense 1b: (mit ʕal ruḥo) eine Schuld oder Verpflichtung auf sich nehmen;

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: (mit ʕal ruḥo) eine Schuld oder Verpflichtung auf sich nehmen;

rationale: An explicit debt object plus reflexive ʕal phrase marks assumed liability, distinguished from ordinary approval or receiving. One attestation.

summary: New sense 1c: (mit m-) jdm. danken, jds. Bemühungen dankbar anerkennen;

data.label: 1c
data.gloss: (mit m-) jdm. danken, jds. Bemühungen dankbar anerkennen;

rationale: Maqbeli minux occurs while declining the offered intervention (Ono lo+kobaʕno); its function is gratitude rather than acceptance of the proposal. One attestation, pending confirmation of conventionality.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) angenommen, erhört werden;
rationale: Supplies the omitted Detransitive gloss for the existing prayer example; this corresponds to III.1 acceptance/hearing, not III.2 thriving.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (JTM 1.4/4)

data.turoyo: u šarrayḏi w u xerayḏi ənšalla gəmqabli ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: ich hoffe, das Böse und das Gute, das ich getan habe, werden sich die Waage halten.

rationale: New II figurative subsense, one attestation.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (36/42)

data.turoyo: Lu sowo mərlele: "Hani tloṯaḥṣar əšne aṯutu. Lo qadirutu, d mqablutu u šulṭono?"
data.translation: Der Alte sprach: "Es sind jetzt dreizehn Jahre her, daß ihr gekommen seid. Habt ihr denn den Sultan nicht sprechen können?"

rationale: Thin II Infectum cell; 2pl with explicit audience object.

summary: example for sense 1b in Preterit (MAC Besim History of Bsorino/50)

data.turoyo: Hedi ʕal hawxa B̥sorino kul ʕayla ʕal u+daynawo d Mor+Gabriyèl. Hēš kobina, dəmmina, mak+karme nabišóṯene, ŭ mu+săwā̀l gweto ŭ ḥalwo, am+medonani. U+daynawo maqbelan ʕal ruḥayna hul l ʕolam.
data.translation: Then, for this reason, Bsorino, every family is in that debt to Mor Gabriel. We are still giving, let’s say, they’re raisins from our vineyards, and from our cattle cheese and milk, these things. That debt we have taken upon ourselves in perpetuum.

rationale: New liability construction, including the debt antecedent.

summary: example for sense 1c in Preterit (MAC NE Mem and Zin/25)

data.turoyo: Omar, ‘Yabo, ṭro mibarbzi. Maqbeli minux, ṭro mibarbzi kul ḥa lab+botaṯṯe. Ono lo+kobaʕno’.
data.translation: He said, ‘Dad, let them disperse! I am grateful to you, let every one of them disperse to their homes. I don’t want it.’

rationale: New gratitude construction; explicit rejection prevents an acceptance mistranslation.

summary: example for sense 3 in Preterit (PrS 50/39)

data.turoyo: Səmle lu paša ʕaskar, azze r riše. Di qriṯo lə maqballe ʕal Kandar d muskile.
data.translation: Nun nahm der Statthalter Soldaten und zog selber gegen ihn. Das Dorf aber ergriff Kandar's Partei und liess nicht zu, dass man ihn verhaftete.

rationale: First Preterit example for the already listed protective sense 3.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (113/153)

data.turoyo: W maʕlum yo u zlam stene, d arbʕi yawme, d mičək bi raḥa, kowe šmənto kowe ṣpahi, kmaqbəl.
data.translation: Bekanntlich wird ja auch ein Mann, wenn er sich vierzig Tage ausruht, ein bisschen hübsch und macht sich heraus.

rationale: First Infectum example for existing intransitive sense 2.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.2/21)

data.turoyo: Bale mənayye ste d howən čike ḥal dəṯṯe basimo yaʕni zangin, lə kmaqbəli haṯe ʕal ruḥayye. Kḥəšwila xəd šəkəl ʕariye.
data.translation: Doch manche von ihnen, die ein bisschen bessergestellt sind, also wohlhabend, akzeptieren das nicht für sich selbst, sie halten es für eine Art von Schande.

rationale: Distinct explicit accepted object plus reflexive affected-person phrase; seven existing III.1 Infectum examples.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/26)

data.turoyo: Dínaqqa dʔoṯənwa a+mšiḥoye, yani, dínaqqa dmaqəbliwa i+haymonuṯo də Mšiḥo, direk maʕəmriwa ʕito bi+qriṯayo.
data.translation: When the Christians would come, like, when they embraced the faith of Christ, they would immediately build a church in that village.

rationale: Thin III Infectum-wa cell; religious acceptance already included in sense 1.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE interview 1/4)

data.translation: Like, we would accept what our mother and father say.

rationale: Thin III Infectum-wa cell; 1pl with parents’ word as overt object.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (PrS 35/2)

data.turoyo: Mu ṭuro dab Bohta wayye. Mqatliwo ʕam ar rəmoye, lə maqbəliwo u ḥəkəm.
data.translation: Sie führten Krieg gegen die Türken und wollten die Regierung nicht anerkennen.

rationale: Thin III Infectum-wa cell; recognition of political authority.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Talay 1/96)

data.turoyo: "Mən kəmmutu ʕal u nbiyyayḏan?" Omanno: "U nbiyyaṯxu, latyo əšme kṯiwo lo bi tawra w lo bu mgalyun. Yoqsa qay komaqablina u mamro, komaqablina a nbiyye, d kətne a nbiyye day yuḏoye, d kətwayne bi tawra, w i tawra, d kətyo ʕayəd day yuḏoye, qay komaqablina a nbiyyaṯṯe, d hanək walaw ay yuḏonanək ṣləwwe Mşiḥo, elo lə gmaqabliwayna a nbiyyaṯxu?
data.translation: „Und was denkt ihr von unserem Propheten?“ Ich sagte: „Der Name eures Propheten ist weder im Alten Testament, noch im Neuen Testament erwähnt. Warum glauben wir dann an das Wort ... warum glauben wir an die Propheten, die (in erster Linie) Propheten der Juden sind. Sie stehen in der Thora und die Thora gehört den Juden. Warum akzeptieren wir ihre Propheten, obwohl die Juden Christus gekreuzigt haben und lehnen euren Propheten aber ab?

rationale: Thin III Infectum-wa cell to five; rhetorical conditional acceptance of prophets.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (60/325)

data.turoyo: Kəbʕat aqbal ḥurma w kəbʕat lo maqablat.
data.translation: Wenn du willst, sei damit einverstanden, und wenn du willst, sei nicht einverstanden!

rationale: Thin Imperativ cell; shortened aqbal and explicit addressee.

summary: New idiom: maqbele/maqbəl b-rišo 'von Herzen gern annehmen'

data.translation: Sie sprach: Den nehme ich von Herzen gerne an, Vater!

rationale: Search reši returned no entry; maqbeli search returned only the established b-ʕayne idiom. b reši is an additional head-expression for respectful/willing acceptance, related to existing ʕal qarʕi contexts.

summary: An accepted thing plus ʕal ruḥayye (JTM 1.2/21) remains ordinary acceptance in III.1. Protection of a person from hostile action (PrS 50/39) directly exemplifies III.3; mere presence of ʕal is insufficient to choose sense 3.
III.2 thriving remains intransitive even with Preterit l-series morphology. The Detransitive prayer example has m- marking the accepting authority and is corrected separately.
Arabic-shaped maqbul and uncertain maqbəlo are not used to manufacture a verbal Part. Pass. box. Predicative mqabəl d- and qebəl likewise need morphological confirmation.

New sense decisions are deliberately grouped: moral reciprocal balancing under II.1b, liability under III.1b, and gratitude under III.1c. The latter two each have one clear occurrence and are marked as such.
No new formulaic speech-introducer examples are needed. Performative acceptance and thanks are retained only where they establish a construction or idiomatic phrase.
Confirm II rather than vowel-reduced III in reciprocal moral balancing (JTM 1.4/4), and whether equal balancing is conventional.
Is Maqbeli minux a conventional thank-you formula in the politely refusing context? III.1c rests on one attestation.

Confirm qebəl at 52/51, predicative mqabəl d- at 30/81, maqbəlo at JTM 4.5/2 and maqbul at PrS 67/100 as verbal or independent adjectival forms; no new verbal stem or Part. Pass. is established from them.
Confirm maqbela at Lahdo Traitor 2/8 as active with object -a rather than a result predicate.
Check printed maqlbile at 24/97 against the entry’s maqblile; source order and suffix segmentation remain unresolved, so no emendation is made.
Confirm maqablole (60/290), maqabli (63/251), and qmaqblono (97/74) morphology; the proposed Imperativ at 63/251 is withheld.
Is 29/250 an intentional parallel reference?
rationale: 29/73 contains the quoted utterance word for word apart from normalization. 29/250 instead has 'Maqbanno hani kulle. Kulle kmaqbannən ʕal qarʕi', spoken by the young man, with a different translation and context. It does attest the related 'accept on my head' expression. The automatic other-verse warning therefore identifies a nonliteral reference, but the supplied evidence cannot establish whether it was deliberately added as a parallel. Check editorial intent before deleting or relabelling 29/250; replacing it with the already-present 29/73 would duplicate a reference.
